summary: The next deposit window, about 13 November to 10 December 2026, holds several big scheduled events. Nvidia, the largest holding in the Nasdaq-100 and S&P 500 lines, reports after the US close on 17 November, while its board's decision on CEO Jensen Huang is still open. Also due: US October retail sales (17 Nov), UK October CPI and the FOMC minutes (18 Nov), US PCE (25 Nov), the US jobs report (4 Dec), the FOMC decision (9 Dec, with a hike near-certain per CME after the hot October CPI) and US November CPI (10 Dec). US markets are closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving and close early on 27 November. The LSE stays open on both days, so US-equity UCITS lines will quote wider spreads then, and an order should avoid those two sessions and the minutes around a US data release or the Nvidia report. None of this changes a line's structure, access or cost. All events are severity 0 (information): under the decision rules the deposit goes to the most underweight sleeve whatever the calendar says, and event-timing is not an approved signal.

events.issue: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 results due Tue 17 Nov after the US close (call at 5pm ET). This lands in the deposit window while the board's review of CEO Huang is unresolved (shares fell 6-8.6% on 11-12 Nov). Expect a large gap move in Nasdaq-100 and semiconductor lines on 18 Nov. Do not place an order in the hours around the release.
Nvidia, the largest S&P 500 weight, reports on 17 Nov (see ndx100). The same day, US October retail sales are due at 8:30am ET.
FOMC minutes of the 27-28 Oct meeting are due 18 Nov at 2pm ET; the date is from secondary calendars and follows the usual three-week lag. UK October CPI is due the same morning at 7am.

US Thanksgiving: NYSE and Nasdaq are closed on Thu 26 Nov and close early (1pm ET) on Fri 27 Nov. The LSE is open, so USD UCITS lines with US underlyings (VWRA.L, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 lines) trade without a live US hedge market and spreads widen. Avoid placing the deposit order on those two sessions.
US October PCE (the Fed's preferred inflation gauge) is due Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET. The date comes from secondary calendars and is unconfirmed on bea.gov.
US November payrolls are due Fri 4 Dec at 8:30am ET.

FOMC meets 8-9 Dec, with the decision and new projections on 9 Dec at 2pm ET. After the hotter-than-expected October CPI (10 Nov), CME FedWatch prices a December hike as near-certain, with about a 10% chance of 50bp; the 10-year yield touched 5.03%. US November CPI follows on 10 Dec. This is the main rates risk if the deposit lands in early December.

Market dislocation context: SOX fell 12.25% on 5 Nov, its worst day since March 2020, and ended 38.4% below its June record. It has rebounded about 17% but is still below its 200-day average. Semis-heavy lines are far more volatile than usual going into the deposit window.
